# Vector Indexer

Keeps the workspace's vector index up to date. On each run the tool drains batches of recently-changed entities from the `vector-index` queue, computes embeddings for live entities, clears embeddings for tombstoned (deleted) entities, and writes the results back through `UpdateEmbeddingsAsync`. The queue head advances per batch so a later run resumes where this one stopped. See `docs/design/vector-search.md` and `docs/design/scheduled-tools.md`.

## Configuration

This tool has no configurable properties on the tool entity. Batch size (default `100`) is a code-level constructor parameter, and the queue name is fixed to `vector-index`. Embedding backend selection is handled by the data access layer's `ComputeEmbeddingsAsync` implementation.

## Usage

Wire the tool via a `tool-relationship`:

- `participants.tool` — the entity-id of this tool entity.
- `participants.schedule` — a `schedule` entity controlling run cadence. Because the tool drains the queue in a loop until empty, one relationship with a modest schedule (for example every few minutes) is sufficient.
- `participants.target` — typically not needed; the tool works over the workspace-wide vector-index queue.

Set `paused: true` on the relationship to halt indexing without losing queue position; the next un-paused run picks up where the paused one stopped.
